role: Decoupled time integral / complementary constructions and source-valid counterexamples

theorems.statement: If Z in R^k is independent of W with joint density cap M_Z, C(W) has joint density cap M_C, B is invertible, and Q=R(W)+P(Z)+2 Z^T B C(W), with arbitrary measurable P and R, then |phi_Q(t)|^2 <= min(1, M_Z M_C pi^k |det B|^{-1}|t|^{-k}). For k>1 this gives L2 density and linear independent-copy collision small ball; for k>2 it gives a continuous bounded density.
theorems.dependence_scope: C coordinates may be fully dependent; no post-rotation independence; independent-copy identity kept only for whole Q-Q'.

theorems.statement: For the exact angular packet Q=a^{-1}(H0+beta Z1+m Z2)^2+2 sigma U Z1 with a genuine physical pivot inside H0 and q perpendicular v, |phi_Q(t)|^2 <= min(1, 2^{3/2} pi^2 (|sigma|m)^{-1}|t|^{-2}).
theorems.partner_application: account03/B03 r36 effective-dimension Riesz gives integral |t|^{-1/2}|phi|^2 <= (16/3)2^{3/8}sqrt(pi)(|sigma|m)^{-1/4}, E|Q-Q'|^{-1/2} <= (16/3)2^{-1/8}(|sigma|m)^{-1/4}, and P(|Q-Q'|<=eps) <= 2^{11/4}(|sigma|m)^{-1/2}eps.

target_valid_obstruction.conclusion: s_3(A_eta)=1 while the angular Jacobian scale |sigma|m=eta tends to zero; therefore s_3(A)>=1 does not force |sigma|m>=c.
target_valid_obstruction.pinned_receiver: Using pinned e5 one-coordinate completion and the exact residual bound sup_s E|2UV-s|^{-1/2}<=7 gives ||p_{Q_eta}||_infinity<=7 uniformly in eta and all cap-one product inputs.

corrections_preserved: No conditional cap for conjugate sum/difference variables.
No law-uniform pointwise quadratic-phase Fourier decay.
No universal good physical minor or universal rank-three cross cut.
Arbitrary-shear dyadic ar^2 tube estimate is false; later logarithmic affine-shear correction preserved.

next_implication.statement: For each remaining angular survivor, extract product-preservingly either a square-plus-bilinear receiver with usable |a sigma|, a grouped square/crossing receiver exploiting the transverse m^2/|a| resource when large, or an already-paid exact-coloop/ridge/nonzero-three-volume exit. The switch cannot depend solely on |sigma|m.
